annotations.text:
Every frame here exports as a PNG at exactly the size YouTube wants.

Turn GUIDES OFF first — the dashed boxes are for you, not for the upload.

The squint test:

Zoom the canvas out until a thumbnail is the size of a postage stamp. If you cannot read it, nobody scrolling can either.

That is the only test that matters.

Three words. Four at the very most.

The title bar under the video carries the sentence. The thumbnail carries the hook.

On the Series layout the number badge must stay in exactly this spot every episode.

That repetition is what makes a viewer recognise the next one.
